title: AI 2040: Plan A
description: The AI Futures Project’s conditional scenario for slowing AI development, building international safeguards, and reaching aligned superintelligence in 2040.

version.label: Plan A launch edition
version.notes: Plan A is primarily a recommendation, not the authors’ best guess. Its depicted downstream effects are conditional predictions if the plan is implemented.

attribution.display: Thomas Larsen, Romeo Dean, Brendan Halstead, Eli Lifland, Ryan Greenblatt, and Daniel Kokotajlo · AI Futures Project

milestones.title: AI Transparency Act passes
milestones.summary: Congress responds to AI agents, concentration of power, and tense hearings with an omnibus AI Transparency Act.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2027; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The authors call this incremental policy mixture a prediction, while Plan A itself is primarily a recommendation.

milestones.title: AI dominates the US election
milestones.summary: AI becomes the election’s biggest issue as white-collar work shifts toward managing agents and candidates propose increasingly dramatic responses.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2028; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: This political sequence is part of a recommended-policy scenario, not the authors’ best-guess future.

milestones.title: US and China halt frontier training
milestones.summary: The US and China begin negotiating Plan A and temporarily halt AI training while compute declarations and verification are established.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario says the halt lasts for the rest of 2029; December 31 anchors the end of that stated period.
milestones.uncertainty: The bilateral deal is a recommended intervention that the authors explicitly do not expect by default.

milestones.title: Plan A consortium is established
milestones.summary: A multinational consortium restarts cautious AI development under total research transparency, broad diffusion, safety slowdowns, and reversibility.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2030; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Implementation is assumed successful for the scenario; subsequent effects are the authors’ conditional predictions.

milestones.title: Frontier AI safety cases become mandatory
milestones.summary: Governments shift the burden of proof and require public, adversarially reviewed safety cases before frontier AI releases.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2031; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The scenario also depicts nearly superhuman systems doing about one-third of cognitive labor by midyear.

milestones.title: AI labor drives controlled explosive growth
milestones.summary: Tens of millions of fast AI agents exceed US human cognitive labor while robotics investment and roughly 50% real GDP growth accelerate transformation.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2032; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Economic quantities are model-dependent scenario estimates, not calibrated point forecasts.

milestones.title: Citizen’s Dividend expands
milestones.summary: Compute and robot permit revenue funds a broad Citizen’s Dividend as AI and robot labor displace more human work.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2033; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Redistribution design is partly a policy recommendation; the scenario’s downstream economics are conditional on Plan A.

milestones.title: Mutually assured compute destruction stabilizes deal
milestones.summary: Global compute reaches tens of billions of H100-equivalents while geographically exposed datacenters create a mutually assured compute destruction standoff.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2034; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Compute growth and geopolitical stability depend on the scenario’s deal and industrial assumptions.

milestones.title: Consortium pauses at top-human-expert AI
milestones.summary: The strongest AIs equal or surpass top experts in every field, and the consortium pauses at the strongest capability level it believes humans can control.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2035; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: This is a deliberate governance pause inside Plan A, not the authors’ default expectation.

milestones.title: Top-expert AIs transform work and industry
milestones.summary: About 200 million fast AIs and two billion robots accelerate tasks until physical and institutional bottlenecks dominate.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2036; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Agent, robot, income, and employment quantities are conditional scenario estimates.

milestones.title: AI-accelerated science reshapes society
milestones.summary: Hundreds of millions of top-expert AIs accelerate science by roughly 10–1,000 times across fields, yielding cures, clean energy, and social disruption.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2037; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The scale and social consequences are speculative predictions conditional on the preceding trajectory.

milestones.title: AI alignment becomes a mature science
milestones.summary: Goal and value formation, honesty training, and interpretability mature into a tested science, while the top-expert capability pause continues.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2038; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The authors acknowledge that apparent scientific confidence could still be wrong.

milestones.title: Institutions begin transferring authority to AIs
milestones.summary: Aligned AIs become load-bearing advisers while governments negotiate deeper authority, alignment-based safety cases, and loosening space-economy caps.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The scenario places this development in 2039; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The transition depends on the scenario’s alignment breakthroughs and durable international coordination.

milestones.title: Humanity passes the torch to aligned superintelligence
milestones.summary: Regulators resume capability scaling, institutions hand authority to aligned AIs, and humanity crosses a projected point of no return as trusted superintelligence emerges.
milestones.normalization_rationale: October 25 is a transparent representative anchor for “late October”; the source explicitly says the exact day forecast is almost certainly wrong.
milestones.uncertainty: The source says forecaster AIs project the point of no return for a day in late October with a months-wide 95% interval.
